Professional browser studio · PDF converter · vectorize art · background remove · color lab

Runs in browser Single self-contained HTML
Professional build: PSD/PSB uses ag-psd, TIFF uses UTIF.js, DXF uses dxf-parser, PDF export uses pdf-lib, and vectorization uses ImageTracer. New AI-powered background removal uses @imgly/background-removal. AI/EPS/CDR are handled as professionally as possible in-browser by extracting embedded PDF or preview data when available.

Drop design files here

Supports PSD, PSB, AI, CDR, EPS, SVG, TIFF, DXF, PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP, BMP and more. Everything stays on this device.

DXF is exported as vector PDF. AI stays vector if the file contains an embedded PDF. CDR/EPS/older AI depend on embedded preview or PDF data.

Best results

  • Use PDF-compatible AI files.
  • Use modern CDR files with embedded previews. If conversion fails, the tool now reports CDR container diagnostics.
  • Multi-page TIFF converts to multi-page PDF.

Vector preserved

  • DXF → vector PDF
  • Embedded PDF inside AI/EPS/CDR → extracted directly
  • Other formats render as print-quality image PDF

Important note

  • Pure browser apps cannot fully interpret proprietary Corel/old Illustrator/PostScript structures without embedded preview/PDF. This build extracts embedded PDF/preview when present and reports what was detected inside the CDR.
  • This build fails gracefully and tells you exactly what to re-export when needed.
